subject: Create Geom with custom default colors

messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: Create Geom with custom default colors
parts:
Hi,

i am trying to create a geom and was wondering how i can set default colors based on a parameter?
i.e. my custom geom would have a function like

geom_custom <- function(geom_custom <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, num.colors=3, ...){
  GeomCustom$new(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, num.colors=num.colors, ...)
}

the data has no column/mapping for colors, i would create that in the reparameterise or draw function based on parameter num.colors.

My plan is to provide hardcoded default colors for num.colors=1-4 and use a function to generate 'higher order' color schemes.

Outside a Geom i could simply do

p = p + scale_fill_manual(values=colors,breaks=colorbreaks, labels=labels)

But within a Geom I don't know how to do this. I looked various Geom functions like default_aes

Thank you,
Thomas
